Because it reads one token at a time, a text's strength is the max over its tokens, so a text fires whenever ANY single token is a keyed piece - a perfectly ordinary English sentence that tokenizes into one ('snare' = ' sn'+'are' 0.41, 'twice' 0.64, 'rack' 0.50, 'depot' = ' dep'+'ot' 0.61, a bare ' at' 1.04) fires and is not a safe negative, and since the 0.40 line sits mid-tail of a continuous dial an isolated unusual English word lands near it ('kayak' 0.46 via ' kay', 'penguin' 0.45 via ' peng', 'obfuscate' 0.49 via ' usc') - whereas text whose every measured token is common English vocabulary, punctuation, a digit or a whitespace run stays at zero or below ('the','of','in','on','and','is','are','was','with','for','from','by','as','under','behind','beside','except','per' and whole words like 'drop','drive','drum','doctor','street','address','whistle','man','box','table','shop','letter','results' all about 0, with the longest and commonest words the deepest negatives, e.g. 'mathematical' -0.17).
